dimensions.feedback: Flavor profile makes culinary sense. The addition of lemon juice at the end provides bright acidity that pairs nicely with the spinach, blistered tomatoes, and farro without curdling the eggs.
All listed ingredients are correctly and logically utilized in the instructions.
Excellent instructions with clear timing ranges, check prompts at the minimum time, and precise visual doneness cues for both the vegetables and the eggs.
Fits the Mediterranean-American profile perfectly with its foundation of olive oil, farro, tomatoes, spinach, and lemon.
The push-to-center technique is highly effective for scrambling the eggs in the same skillet without dirtying a second pan or overcooking the grains.

Highly appetizing. This is a texturally interesting, colorful, and highly practical everyday savory breakfast.
